cases.canadian_business_activity: Produces nonwoven fabrics for use by North American manufacturers of waterproofing products.
cases.exclusion_reason: First-operation outcome date and event-time feature availability not established
cases.audit_note: CIPO application 2198269 was filed by Tiandingfeng Nonwovens Co., Ltd. on 2022-07-14 for non-woven fabrics and related class 24 goods, more than eight months before Tiandingfeng Canada Nonwovens Co., Ltd. was incorporated on 2023-03-30 and roughly fifteen months before the October 2023 Investment Canada notification. This is a Canada-specific pre-incorporation market-intent signal, not proof of Canadian operations. Sorel-Tracy council resolution 2025-03-197 later ratified a 2025-02-26 promise of purchase with Tiandingfeng Canada for industrial land, confirming eventual physical-project development after the notification. Neither source establishes the first local manufacturing date or resolves why the Investment Canada record reports France as ultimate control while the pre-entry trademark applicant is a Chinese Tiandingfeng entity. Keep the case UNRESOLVED and model-ineligible.

cases.canadian_business_activity: Sells and distributes veterinary biologicals.
cases.exclusion_reason: First-operation outcome date and event-time feature availability not established
cases.audit_note: Vaxxinova's official 2024-03-04 announcement states that its BU Aqua business unit provides biological preventive solutions to the aquaculture industry in Canada. This predates Vaxxinova Canada, Inc.'s 2024-07-18 incorporation and the May 2025 Investment Canada notification, and therefore corroborates Canada-facing group activity before the local vehicle existed. CIPO also records Vaxxinova International B.V.'s VAXXINOVA Canadian trademark filed in 2018 and registered in 2021 for veterinary vaccines/services, but that application claimed proposed use and is not treated as proof of operations. Neither source establishes when Vaxxinova Canada itself first sold or distributed veterinary biologicals. Keep the operating outcome UNRESOLVED and model-ineligible.
